initial_candidate.note: The first measured candidate fetched input statistics again on the non-singleton fallback. Final code shares the byte/row comparison with the existing helper and reuses the already fetched statistics. Selection behavior is unchanged.

limitations: The optional dependency patch is disabled by default. It changes CrossJoinExec build-side selection only for exact row counts of one versus more than one when join reordering is enabled.

The existing fallback still applies to empty, inexact, unknown and other cardinalities. This is not a general cross-join cost model, and very wide singleton payloads or different batching may behave differently.
